$comment: SeamlessAI provider catalog. Models are ranked by score (quality, live reliability and speed, today's remaining allowance, how permanent the free offer is); catalog order breaks ties. 'qualityScore' is the share of `seamless test` checks a model passed in our own runs; 'avgMs' is its average answer time in those runs; 'tier' is the starting guess for models we haven't scored. A user's own test results override both. 'tools': false means the model can't take tool-calling requests; leave it out when unknown. Limits are the published free-tier limits; the router also learns from 429s and retry-after headers. 'verified' records when the entry was last checked and how.

providers.notes: Very fast, but only 8,000 tokens per minute, so big agent requests go elsewhere.
